subject: Inventory stowaway: finalize GPU soft-pledge for Helion Nexus
raw_messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inventory stowaway: finalize GPU soft-pledge for Helion Nexus

Team —

Helion Nexus is at final legal and procurement and is asking for a short soft-pledge while they finish the PO (deal HN-4721). They want to lock capacity for an initial prod rollout (latency-sensitive chat inference) and then ramp over 6–8 weeks.

High level ask from Sales/Customer: a 30–45 day soft hold on a dedicated slice (they'll confirm model/seq once legal signs). They asked specifically for an A100-equivalent footprint with headroom for burst.

Can you confirm what we can safely hold without impacting other committed reserved pools? If we can, please propose:
- exact GPU count + node mapping (us-west/us-east split)
- whether this needs dedicated pool reservation or can be staged with burst caps
- how long we can hold (policy + operational risk)
- template verbiage for a soft-pledge doc (to send to the customer)

Attaching the most recent capacity estimate Helion provided (helion_capacity_demand_v2.xlsx).

—Markus

----

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inventory stowaway: finalize GPU soft-pledge for Helion Nexus

Markus —

Thanks for the heads-up and the attachment. I reviewed the demand vector and our current reserved commitments. Short answer: we can support a 30-day soft-pledge for the footprint they described, but with conditions. Summary below: 

1) Proposed hold: 24 A100-equivalent GPUs (12 us-west / 12 us-east) mapped as 6 nodes (4x A100 per node), hold id STOW-4721. This gives them baseline throughput for initial production and room for a short burst window.

2) Reservation model: implement as a "soft reserved slice" in Dedicated: capacity is earmarked (no billing change until PO), with an operational flag that allows reclaiming after 30 days if a firm commitment is not received. We can extend to 45 days with executive signoff.

3) Impact and mitigations: Q3 is heavier in other late-stage deals. If we take this hold without a firm start date we increase risk of transient throttles for opportunistic burst customers. Mitigation: allow cross-region fallback (route to compatible quantized variant) and a hard cap on sustained throughput. We'll document the fallback policy in the soft-pledge doc.

4) Required inputs from Sales/CS: earliest expected start date, target QPS, and whether they require GPU KV caching persistence across restarts (that would raise the per-node memory requirements).

5) Ops steps (high level): create STOW-4721 in the capacity ledger, mark nodes in the Dedicated scheduler, tag the nodes with hold metadata, and schedule an infra checkpoint. I'll generate the soft-pledge template and the hold record once we have the PO window.

Attachments: redwood_softpledge_template.pdf (draft)

I'll prepare a short note for the execs if you want a 45-day exception.

—Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Manager
Redwood Inference

----

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@helionnexus.com>, procurement@helionnexus.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inventory stowaway: finalize GPU soft-pledge for Helion Nexus

Evan / Helion team —

Thanks for moving fast here. Karthik confirms operationally we can earmark a soft hold. Proposed customer-facing approach:

- Redwood will place a 30-day soft-pledge on 24 A100-equivalent GPUs (hold id STOW-4721) split 12/12 across us-west/us-east.
- The soft-pledge documents operational behavior (no immediate billing; capacity held from the pool and made available to you on start).
- If a PO is not received within 30 days, Redwood may reclaim the hold with 72 hours' notice, unless the parties agree to a written extension.

Next steps from you to make this operational:
1) Confirm acceptance of the soft-pledge terms in principle (reply OK).
2) Share procurement contact (name + email) to receive the soft-pledge doc and PO instructions.
3) Confirm earliest preferred start week (week of mm/dd).

I've attached the draft soft-pledge for quick review. If you confirm today we can create STOW-4721 and assign the nodes.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
